title: University Expansion — Who Builds It?
notebook: The expansion adds four buildings and grows the campus forty percent.
Theron: the State Bureau builds adequate, functional halls. Vael can deliver architecture, if we pay for it.
The foreign consortium completed the Lytheirian National University expansion last year.

narrative.text: The university expansion will add four new buildings — sciences, humanities, library, and student housing. The campus will grow by forty percent. The Dean is concerned about one thing above all: that the construction respects the university's character and the surrounding neighborhood.

The State Bureau would build functional structures — adequate but uninspired. Vael's group can deliver architectural quality if we pay for it. The foreign consortium has experience building modern university facilities — they completed the Lytheirian National University expansion last year. The question is not just who builds it, but what kind of university we are building for.

choices.text: "State Bureau. Functional, adequate, Veltrian. The buildings will serve the students — that is what matters."
"Vael Construction. If we are building a university for the next century, we build it properly. Quality architecture, quality materials. Vael's markup is the price of excellence."
"Foreign consortium with university experience. They have done this before. Their expertise will elevate the entire project."
